bibl.title: Κλέος ἄφθιτον in Sappho fr. 44.4 V.
bibl.seg: Ruobing Xian, Κλέος ἄφθιτον in Sappho fr. 44.4 V.
bibl.note: Argues for a sophisticated reading of the phrase κλέος ἄφθιτον at Sappho fr. 44.4 V. in light of two Homeric sources (Il. 9.413. 7.91). This is a more sophisticated reading of Sappho's art of allusion than recognized before, namely the use of "window reference". - 1. Sappho fr. 44 V. and the Iliad. - 2. A new look at Sappho fr. 44.4 V. - 3. Further considerations.
